description: This Python script generates application sections for xb1 using templates, handling command-line arguments for application name, template path, product, output, and configuration. It reads templates, applies product settings, and writes the generated XML to a file.

methods.name: _GenerateApplicationSection
methods.description: Generates an application section XML using a template, application name, config, and product settings.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and writes the generated application section to the specified output file.
